function.name: get_box_score
function.description: Per-player box score: PTS, FGM/FGA, 3PM/3PA, FTM/FTA, OREB/DREB/REB, TOV, PF, grouped by team and sorted by points. Only players who appeared are listed. period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_team_stats
function.description: Team totals for a game or a single period: PTS, FGM/FGA and FG%, 3PM/3PA and 3P%, FTM/FTA and FT%, OREB/DREB/REB, TOV, PF. Percentages are 0-100. FGA and 3PA exclude shots missed while fouled. REB and TOV include team rebounds and team turnovers.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). It is a model judgment from broadcast tracking, not defender distance: about 70% of shots are flagged contested, it separates 2-point shots well but barely separates 3-point shots, and about 2% of shots have no contest label and are left out when this filter is used. Treat it as approximate.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

contested.description: true = contested shots only (contest level average, plus or blocked), false = uncontested only (open or light). Omit for all shots. Approximate; see the tool description.

function.name: get_picks
function.description: On-ball screens (pick-and-rolls and pick-and-pops): how many, on how many possessions, the points the offense scored on those possessions, and a breakdown by defensive coverage. Coverage is given twice: on the ball handler (over, under, switch, ice, blitz) and on the screener (show, soft, switch, ice, blitz, none). Points count the whole possession, not only scores created by the pick.

function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). It is a model judgment from broadcast tracking, not defender distance: about 70% of shots are flagged contested, it separates 2-point shots well but barely separates 3-point shots, and about 2% of shots have no contest label and are left out when this filter is used. Treat it as approximate.

game_id.description: SkillCorner game id, e.g. "191313". One of the 10 published ACB 2025-2026 games.

team.description: Team name, full or partial (e.g. "Zaragoza" or "Leche Rio Breogan"). Must be one of the two teams in the game.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). It is a model judgment from broadcast tracking, not defender distance: about 70% of shots are flagged contested, it separates 2-point shots well but barely separates 3-point shots, and about 2% of shots have no contest label and are left out when this filter is used. Treat it as approximate.

game_id.description: SkillCorner game id, e.g. "191313". One of the 10 published ACB 2025-2026 games.

team.description: Team name, full or partial (e.g. "Zaragoza" or "Leche Rio Breogan"). Must be one of the two teams in the game. Filters to shots taken by that team.

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Spissu" or "Marco Spissu"). Must be on one of the two rosters; an ambiguous name returns an error listing the candidates. Filters to shots taken by that player.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

three_pt.description: true = 3-point shots only, false = 2-point shots only. Omit for both.

contested.description: true = contested shots only (contest level average, plus or blocked), false = uncontested only (open or light). Omit for all shots. Approximate; see the tool description.

function.name: get_picks
function.description: On-ball screens (pick-and-rolls and pick-and-pops): how many, on how many possessions, the points the offense scored on those possessions, and a breakdown by defensive coverage. Coverage is given twice: on the ball handler (over, under, switch, ice, blitz) and on the screener (show, soft, switch, ice, blitz, none). Points count the whole possession, not only scores created by the pick.

team.description: Team name, full or partial (e.g. "Zaragoza" or "Leche Rio Breogan"). Must be one of the two teams in the game. Filters to picks run by that team on offense. Omit for both teams.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_box_score
function.description: Per-player box score: PTS, FGM/FGA, 3PM/3PA, FTM/FTA, OREB/DREB/REB, TOV, PF, grouped by team and sorted by points. Only players who appeared are listed. FGA and 3PA exclude shots missed while fouled. With `period`, every stat (free throws included) covers that period only, so this is the tool for a player's points, rebounds or fouls in a single quarter.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_team_stats
function.description: Team totals for a game or a single period: PTS, FGM/FGA and FG%, 3PM/3PA and 3P%, FTM/FTA and FT%, OREB/DREB/REB, TOV, PF. Percentages are 0-100. FGA and 3PA exclude shots missed while fouled. REB and TOV include team rebounds and team turnovers.

game_id.description: SkillCorner game id, e.g. "191313". One of the 10 published ACB 2025-2026 games.

team.description: Team name, full or partial (e.g. "Zaragoza" or "Leche Rio Breogan"). Must be one of the two teams in the game.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). It is a model judgment from broadcast tracking, not defender distance: about 70% of shots are flagged contested, it separates 2-point shots well but barely separates 3-point shots, and about 2% of shots have no contest label and are left out when this filter is used. Treat it as approximate.

team.description: Team name, full or partial (e.g. "Zaragoza" or "Leche Rio Breogan"). Must be one of the two teams in the game. Filters to shots taken by that team.

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Spissu" or "Marco Spissu"). Must be on one of the two rosters; an ambiguous name returns an error listing the candidates. Filters to shots taken by that player.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

three_pt.description: true = 3-point shots only, false = 2-point shots only. Omit for both.

contested.description: true = contested shots only (contest level average, plus or blocked), false = uncontested only (open or light). Omit for all shots. Approximate; see the tool description.

function.name: get_picks
function.description: On-ball screens (pick-and-rolls and pick-and-pops): how many, on how many possessions, the points the offense scored on those possessions, and a breakdown by defensive coverage. Coverage is given twice: on the ball handler (over, under, switch, ice, blitz) and on the screener (show, soft, switch, ice, blitz, none). Points count the whole possession, not only scores created by the pick.

period.description: Period to restrict to: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for the quarters, 5 for the first overtime, 6 for a second overtime. Omit for the full game.

function.name: get_shots
function.description: Field goal attempts, makes, FG% (0-100) and points for the shots matching the filters. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Free throws are not included, and attempts exclude shots missed while fouled. A shot is 'contested' when SkillCorner's contestLevel is average, plus or blocked, and 'uncontested' when it is open or light (this is the dataset's own `contested` flag). It is a model judgment from broadcast tracking, not defender distance: about 70% of shots are flagged contested, it separates 2-point shots well but barely separates 3-point shots, and about 2% of shots have no contest label and are left out when this filter is used. Treat it as approximate.
